messages:
zoe: opening thread for 'route-safeguard v2' rollout plan. core asks: deterministic tenant cohorts, staged regions, shadow A/B for quality, and a clear fallback + soft-pause API.
harry: suggest deterministic tenant lists (give us auditability) + reserve a 0% internal QA cohort for smoke. avoid loose pct-based global slices.
mira: telemetry hard-stop ideas: p99 latency up >20% OR client error +0.5% absolute over 10m -> pause cohort. token-spend anomaly (+35%) should trigger immediate throttle.
ops-bot: alert-bot: composite alert created: route-safeguard-v2 (p99_delta_10m=20, err_abs_10m=0.5, token_spend_pct=35). pages when cohort_rps>1.
joel: fallback choreography: on hard-stop, swap affected tenants to pinned route 'stable-v1' and set rollout=PAUSED. auto-retry after 15m; if metrics stable for 8m, resume. manual rollback window = 45m.
devops: add burst protection: require both 5m and 15m windows to exceed thresholds before paging, prevents transient noise.
zoe: shadow A/B: mirror sampled traffic to v2-small for 48-72h, compute quality delta, redact PII, store artifacts for 14d. do not surface in customer metrics.
harry: soft-pause API needed: POST /flags/{flag}/pause?tenant={id} — ops can pause single tenant immediately. also provide GET /flags/{flag}/status for quick checks.
mira: playbook checklist before region expand: 1) internal QA passes smoke 2) shadow run >=48h and quality delta <2% 3) golden cohort stable 24h 4) soft-pause and resume exercised by oncall.
joel: add token-quota guard: if tenant uses >90% daily quota, shed to fallback model automatically.
zoe: config snippet I like: ```json
{"flag":"route_safeguard_v2","cohorts":[{"name":"enterprise","tenants_count":10}],"regions":["us-west1","eu-west1"],"fallback":"stable-v1","soft_pause_endpoint":"/flags/{flag}/pause"}```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary started -> us-west1, cohort=enterprise-10, rollout_id=roll-1770032100. hooks: latency,error,token_spend,quality.
devops: scheduling 30m dry-run tomorrow to exercise pause/resume and auto-retry. please ack when you've reviewed runbook.
zoe: Ack.
harry: Ack.
mira: Ack.
